FX-THRESH-001.says: Level 128, the setting as it starts: black, blue, the line, red, the dark grey and grey 127 turn black; grey 128, exactly on the level, turns white, as do the shadow skin, green, the light grey, the skin and white; the soft skin turns white and the soft line black, each at its own half covering.

FX-THRESH-002.says: Level 0: every shown pixel turns white, black too; the soft edges are white at half covering.

FX-THRESH-003.says: Level 255: only white stays white; every other shown pixel, the skin and the light grey too, turns black.

FX-THRESH-004.says: Level 20: only black and blue, the darkest, turn black; the line, darker to the eye than red but brighter than blue, turns white.

FX-THRESH-005.says: Level 50: red, at luma 54, turns white while blue and the line stay black: a pure red counts as brighter than a pure blue.

FX-THRESH-006.says: Level 64: the dark grey sits exactly on the level and turns white; red, just below, turns black.

FX-THRESH-007.says: Level 127: grey 127 is now exactly on the level and turns white, with grey 128.

FX-THRESH-008.says: Level 128.5, a level between two 8-bit steps: grey 128 turns black, with grey 127.

FX-THRESH-009.says: Level 172: the shadow skin, at luma 171.3, turns black while the lit skin stays white, the cel split into its light and its shadow.

FX-THRESH-010.says: Level 185: pure green, at luma 182.4, turns black; the light grey, at 192, stays white.

FX-THRESH-011.says: Level keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 255 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is FX-THRESH-002, frame 2 level 127.5, grey 127 black and grey 128 white, and frame 4 FX-THRESH-003; the pixels turn black darkest first.

FX-THRESH-012.says: Level held at 50 from frame 0, then 185 from frame 3: frames 0 and 2 are FX-THRESH-005, frames 3 and 4 FX-THRESH-010.

FX-THRESH-013.says: Level eased from 128 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 the level has gone below 0 and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 are both FX-THRESH-002.

FX-THRESH-014.says: FX-THRESH-001 moved three pixels right: the same, moved.

FX-THRESH-015.says: Level -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-THRESH-016.says: Level 256, above 255. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-THRESH-017.says: Level 255.5, past 255 by half a step. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-THRESH-018.says: Level keyed to 300 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-THRESH-019.says: Level written "128", a word, not a number. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
